verdict.rationale: Tailscale's own docs claim infrastructure access wherever resources live, including Kubernetes clusters, across clouds and on-prem, with auditable K8s access and a documented Kubernetes sidecar deployment. Community users independently confirm the k8s operator and dev/staging/prod infrastructure access. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the Kubernetes operator and API-server access flow (the evidence has only marketing-level summaries and a sidecar guide).

support.subject: As a developer, I can get secure infrastructure access to resources wherever they live, including Kubernetes clusters

citations.quote: Infrastructure access to wherever your resources live, including Kubernetes clusters
Across clouds or on-prem, Tailscale’s mesh overlay network connects it all.
Auditable access to SSH, K8s, databases, and more.
Run the Tailscale container image as a sidecar in Kubernetes with persistent state, DNS configuration, authentication, and routing guidance.
The k8s operator is also great.
